pull.title: KAFKA-20925: Use request header v3 for the share group state RPCs
pull.body:
Jira: https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/KAFKA-20925

KIP-1313:
https://cwiki.apache.org/confluence/spaces/KAFKA/pages/406624038/KIP-1313+Client+instance+ID+in+all+request+headers

This PR adds metadata version 4.5-IV0 and new versions of the share
group state RPCs that use the v3 request header: ReadShareGroupState v1,
WriteShareGroupState v2, InitializeShareGroupState v1,
DeleteShareGroupState v1 and ReadShareGroupStateSummary v2. The share
group state persister sends the new versions only when the metadata
version is 4.5-IV0 or later, so brokers keep using the v2 request header
until every broker in the cluster supports v3. Like the other v3 request
header versions, the new versions are marked unstable.

Reviewers: Andrew Schofield <aschofield@confluent.io>

review_comments.body: Let's have a null check on `metadataCache.metadataVersion()` and return false if it's null.
For completeness, let's add the comment for the new versions similar to the requests. I understand that request header is not in the response :) Let's leave it all tidy.
Let's put the calculation of `cacheHelper.isRequestHeaderV3Supported()` outside the loop and the synchronised block.
nit: We tend to use LATEST not LAST for RPC versions.
That is neater for sure. Thanks. @alanlau28

issue_comments.body:
Thanks for the review @AndrewJSchofield. I've also removed `latestVersionUnstable` from the RPCs given they are inter-broker. 

> Let's put the calculation of cacheHelper.isRequestHeaderV3Supported() outside the loop and the synchronised block.

Doing this exposed a startup case. The persister's send thread starts before the broker loads its first metadata image, and `generateRequests()` runs on every pass, including the first pass, when there's nothing to send. Before that first image, `metadataCache.metadataVersion()` throws `IllegalStateException` rather than returning `null`. The send thread treated that as fatal, and a broker exited during startup. So `isRequestHeaderV3Supported()` now returns `false` in that case. The next pass reads the real version.

issue.title: KAFKA-20925: Derive the share group state request versions from the request header version

repository.name: kafka
repository.description: Apache Kafka - A distributed event streaming platform

issue.body:
Follow-up to review comments on #23821.
The share group state RPCs capped their latest version with a hardcoded `LATEST_VERSION_BEFORE_REQUEST_HEADER_V3` constant per request, chosen by a boolean from `MetadataVersion`. `MetadataVersion` now returns the request header version directly, and `ApiKeys` looks up the latest API version that uses that header version or lower, so the builders take the header version and the per-request constants are removed.
